Solution Architect  
   
 PERSOL is one of Australia's largest and longest serving recruitment providers. Delivering both quality temporary and permanent options, we specialise in the recruitment of Professional, ICT, Government, STEM, Management and Executive talent. 
 Our client is looking for an experienced Solution Architect to join a high-performing team delivering complex and innovative software solutions within a large-scale industrial and technology environment. 
   
 Roster:                  Monday-Friday Perth based 
 Start date:           ASAP 
 Duration:             approx. 12 months - depending on client requirements 
 Pay Rate:              $110.00 p/h + Super depending on experience 
   
  Please note that only people with relevant experience will be considered and contacted.  
   
  The Role:   
 This position plays a critical role in bridging business requirements and technical implementation, ensuring solutions are scalable, efficient and aligned with broader product strategies and architectural standards. 
 Working closely with Product Owners, Software Architects, Systems Engineers, Development Teams and QA, you will be responsible for designing solutions that extend and enhance existing systems while supporting seamless integration across multiple technologies and platforms. 
   
  Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:     
 
 Develop solution designs aligned with established architecture frameworks, product standards and high-level system designs. 
 Translate business and product requirements into detailed technical solutions and implementation plans. 
 Break solution designs into clear and actionable work packages for software delivery teams. 
 Define system dependencies and interface requirements to ensure successful integration across multiple components and systems. 
 Ensure all solution designs comply with functional safety and engineering requirements. 
 Analyse existing systems and identify opportunities for enhancement, optimisation and standardisation. 
 Provide technical guidance and design support throughout the development lifecycle. 
 Define API and third-party integration methods in accordance with established standards. 
 Select and recommend appropriate technologies and frameworks for efficient implementation. 
 Produce and maintain architecture documentation, including system diagrams, component interactions and data flows. 
 
  Required Experience:   
 
 Extensive experience designing and delivering complex software solutions. 
 Strong understanding of software engineering principles and best practices.

 Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

  Highly Regarded:   
 
 Experience within mining, industrial technology, autonomous systems, robotics, defence or heavy industry environments.

 Experience working across multidisciplinary engineering and software teams.

LD Total is a multi-award winning landscape company specialising in landscape architecture services, irrigation design, commercial landscape construction, maintenance and residential lot packages. 

At LD Total, our design team play an active role in shaping the company and the landscape with the focus on quality and innovative design and delivery of projects. 

In order to support the continued growth of our business in WA, LD Total is seeking appointment of a Landscape Architect to assist in providing fully integrated Landscape Architecture design and delivery of master planned land development communities including public open spaces, public sector projects, playgrounds, industrial estates, urban projects, and ecological projects.

There is the opportunity to further develop your professional and technical knowledge in all aspects of the landscaping industry through regular team building and social / professional networking events and UDIA / AILA affiliations.

As a Design & Construct company we work alongside our construction team to ensure our landscape vision hits the ground. This means more time to design and work with our clients and less time spent undertaking contractual tasks. We work with a range of clients in Perth, from the large diversified property groups through to smaller developers and builders.

- Design, drafting and technical support for landscape projects on a variety of project sizes and complexities
- Excellent communication and project coordination skills
 -Self-motivated, professional and reliable

A remuneration package between $79,500 to $85,000 per annum + super will be offered to the successful candidate.

How to Apply

The Role

We are hiring a Software Engineer who will single-handedly analyse, design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and document full-stack operational systems serving Chinese clients across semiconductor, MCU, and cross-border business domains. This is not a narrowly scoped position — the successful candidate must independently manage the complete lifecycle of multiple concurrent software systems, from requirements gathering with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders through to production deployment on China-compliant infrastructure.

The role requires a rare combination of full-stack software engineering, hands-on Linux server administration, working familiarity with IC design and EDA tool environments, and the ability to operate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese across technical, business, and compliance contexts. The candidate will be the primary technical owner of all systems and must be capable of working without supervision across all layers of the stack and across all stages of delivery.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and document full-stack web applications end-to-end — including React or Vue front-end interfaces, Python-based backend services, relational databases, RESTful APIs, authentication systems, and administrative dashboards — within a single-engineer ownership model.
- Build and maintain internal tools, management systems, workflow dashboards, and client-facing operational platforms for cross-border Chinese SMEs, semiconductor companies, and engineering teams, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms (WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-specific cloud APIs) using Chinese-language API documentation.
- Develop and maintain software tools, scripts, and workflow automation systems that support IC design operations, including DFT workflows, Verilog-based digital logic design, verification pipelines, and EDA tool environments (Cadence and Synopsys) — covering environment configuration, licence server management, and build-flow automation.
- Deploy, configure, monitor, and maintain applications on Linux-based server environments across Mainland China and international infrastructure, including ICP-filed domains, China-based hosting, cross-border DNS and CDN configuration, reverse proxy setup (Nginx), and environment-specific application configuration. Troubleshoot infrastructure issues specific to China-facing deployments, including Great Firewall constraints and dual-environment architectures.
- Identify technology limitations, performance bottlenecks, and process gaps across existing systems, then independently design, implement, and document improvements — maintaining technical documentation, API references, deployment runbooks, and operational procedures in both English and Chinese.
- Analyse operational metrics, system performance data, user feedback, and error reports to drive continuous improvement across all systems under management.
- Serve as the primary technical point of contact for bilingual teams, Chinese clients, and stakeholders across China, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Australia, conducting requirements gathering and technical communication in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Technical Requirements

Required

- Hands-on experience in full-stack web development, with demonstrated ability to independently deliver complete systems from front-end to backend to deployment.
- Strong proficiency in Python as a primary backend language, with production experience in Django, Flask, or FastAPI for building database-backed web applications and API services.
- Production experience developing front-end interfaces using React or Vue (not merely prototyping), including state management, component architecture, API integration, and responsive design.
- Demonstrated experience building and maintaining internal tools, admin panels, operational dashboards, and workflow management platforms for business users.
- Solid understanding of RESTful API design, relational database modelling (PostgreSQL or MySQL), authentication and authorisation systems, third-party API integration, and system-to-system communication patterns.
- Hands-on Linux server administration experience, including setup, configuration, application deployment, Nginx reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS management, firewall rules, log management, cron jobs, process supervision, and production troubleshooting — not merely development on Linux.
- Practical experience with Docker containerisation, CI/CD pipeline configuration, and cloud or hybrid server deployment environments.
- Working knowledge of digital IC design workflows, including an understanding of DFT (Design for Test) concepts, Verilog HDL, digital logic design, synthesis, and verification processes — sufficient to develop, configure, and maintain software tools and workflow integrations that support IC design engineering teams.
- Direct experience working with EDA tool environments, specifically Cadence and/or Synopsys toolchains, including at least one of: tool installation and environment configuration, licence server setup and management, build-flow scripting and automation, or integration of EDA tools into broader engineering workflow platforms.
- Familiarity with ARM Cortex and/or RISC-V processor architectures and MCU-based development workflows, with sufficient understanding to build and maintain software systems that support semiconductor engineering and production operations.
- Demonstrated experience with Mainland China infrastructure and compliance requirements, including ICP filing processes, China-based hosting configuration, China-accessible domain and DNS setup, and deployment of applications that function reliably behind the Great Firewall.
- Experience building operational software systems for Chinese businesses, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms, services, or APIs (e.g., WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-based cloud providers), with the ability to independently read and implement from Chinese-language technical documentation.

Preferred

- Experience developing automation scripts, engineering workflow tools, internal development platforms, or integration layers specifically for semiconductor or IC design teams in China.
- Understanding of MCU, semiconductor, embedded systems, or IC design industries in Greater China and broader Asia, particularly where software platforms support engineering, production, or client delivery workflows.
- Experience with software performance optimisation, security hardening, monitoring and alerting systems, and deployment automation for production environments operating across multiple jurisdictions.
- Familiarity with cross-border data handling, dual-environment deployment architectures (China/international), and the operational constraints of running software services that must function in both mainland Chinese and international network environments simultaneously.
- Experience working in small teams or as a sole technical operator with full ownership of systems from requirements through to production support.

Language & Communication

- Proficient in English.
- Fluent Mandarin Chinese, both spoken and written, is required.
- Ability to communicate technical requirements, system issues, software specifications, and deployment matters with Chinese clients and Mandarin-speaking stakeholders.
- Ability to read and interpret Chinese platform documentation, API documentation, compliance materials, and technical communication; draft technical communications in Chinese for mainland stakeholders; and navigate Chinese-language developer resources, forums, and support channels without assistance.

UTS College provides a pathway for students into the University of Technology, Sydney (UTS), one of Australia's leading universities, and it is our vision to actualise potential and enhance lives through the power of learning, our actions and our people. Our purpose is to provide the best available opportunity for students to develop the knowledge, skills & attributes they need to attain their goals through market-leading courses, teaching excellence and an emphasis on the student experience.

About the Role
The Systems Engineer provides technical leadership and capability across project and business-as-usual activities. The role is responsible for designing, implementing, configuring, maintaining and optimising applications, network and server infrastructure that enable UTS College business operations.

The position contributes to the architecture, configuration, testing and deployment of applications and supporting infrastructure across both on premise and cloud-based environments. It plays a key role in resolving complex incidents, improving system reliability and performance, and delivering infrastructure enhancements aligned to business priorities.

Responsibilities
•	Undertakes or supervises complex installations and de-installations of systems or components, including handover
•	Schedules installation work around priorities and resource availability.
•	Monitors and manages incident queues to ensure incidents are handled according to procedures and service levels.
•	Contributes to developing, testing and improving incident management procedures. Uses analytics tools to track trends.
•	Applies technical expertise to maintain and optimise network infrastructure, executing updates and employing automation tools.
•	Uses network management tools to monitor load, performance, and security statistics. Investigates and enables the resolution of   network-related operational and security issues.

## Penetration Tester
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and driven Penetration Tester to join our cybersecurity team and play a critical role in identifying and addressing vulnerabilities across our systems, networks, and applications. In this role, you will design and execute comprehensive penetration testing engagements, simulate real-world cyber threats, and deliver actionable insights that strengthen our security posture. The ideal candidate brings strong technical expertise, a methodical approach to problem-solving, and a passion for ethical hacking and offensive security practices.
## Key Responsibilities
- Develop, plan, and execute penetration testing methodologies across networks, web applications, cloud environments, and internal infrastructure to uncover security weaknesses before they can be exploited
- Design detailed test cases through in-depth technical analysis of risks, common vulnerability patterns, and threat intelligence relevant to the organisation's environment
- Produce comprehensive test scripts, materials, and testing packs to evaluate both new and existing software, services, and systems for security vulnerabilities
- Plan and conduct cyber threat emulation activities — including adversary simulation and red team exercises — to validate the effectiveness of technical security controls and identify gaps in defences
- Identify exploitable vulnerabilities and map potential attack vectors into systems, analysing scan results and manual findings to assess the severity and risk of security loopholes
- Carry out social engineering assessments, including simulated phishing campaigns, to evaluate the effectiveness of security awareness programmes and staff resilience to human-focused threats
- Perform thorough post-engagement analysis and produce clear, well-structured reports that communicate technical findings and risk ratings to both technical teams and senior stakeholders
- Provide prioritised, practical remediation recommendations and work collaboratively with development and infrastructure teams to support the resolution of identified vulnerabilities
- Stay current with emerging attack techniques, exploit research, CVEs, and evolving threat landscapes to ensure testing methodologies remain effective and up to date
- Support certification, accreditation, and compliance activities by providing security assurance testing aligned with relevant frameworks and regulatory requirements
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal security testing processes, tooling, and documentation to enhance the team's overall capability and efficiency
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Demonstrated experience in penetration testing, ethical hacking, or a closely related offensive security role
- Proficiency with industry-standard penetration testing tools such as Metasploit, Burp Suite, Nmap, Nessus, Cobalt Strike, or similar
- Strong understanding of network protocols, operating systems (Windows and Linux), web application architectures, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
- Practical knowledge of common vulnerability frameworks and standards, including OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, CVE, and CVSS
- Experience conducting vulnerability assessments, threat modelling, and risk analysis across varied technical environments
- Ability to write clear, professional reports tailored to both technical and non-technical audiences, articulating findings, risks, and recommended remediation actions
- Solid understanding of security principles, defence-in-depth strategies, and secure development practices
- Relevant industry certification such as OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional), CEH, or equivalent
- Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with meticulous attention to detail
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple engagements simultaneously and work effectively both independently and within a collaborative team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Advanced certifications such as OSCE, OSEP, GPEN, GWAPT, or CREST-accredited qualifications
- Experience with red team operations, purple team exercises, or adversary simulation engagements
- Familiarity with scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Ruby for custom tool development and automation
- Exposure to ICS/SCADA, IoT, or operational technology (OT) security testing environments
- Experience working within regulated industries or environments subject to frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, or the Australian Government Information Security Manual (ISM)
- Knowledge of cloud-native security testing techniques and containerised environment assessments
## Why Join Us?
- Work on technically challenging and varied engagements across diverse industries, giving you genuine breadth of experience and ongoing professional growth
- Access a structured professional development budget to pursue advanced certifications, attend industry conferences, and build on your existing skill set
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid options, that support a healthy work-life balance
- Be part of a collaborative, high-performing security team that values knowledge sharing, innovation, and a strong ethical approach to cybersecurity
- Contribute to meaningful work that directly protects organisations and individuals from real-world cyber threats
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Cyber Security Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in safeguarding our software systems, applications, and digital infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining robust security solutions that are fully integrated into our development and operational environments. This role suits a technically adept professional with a strong background in secure software development, vulnerability management, and security architecture who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced setting.

- Collaborate closely with software developers and engineering teams to identify, prioritise, and remediate security vulnerabilities and coding weaknesses in a timely manner
- Participate in code reviews, offering expert security guidance and ensuring that development teams adhere to established security frameworks and best practices
- Design and maintain secure application programming interfaces (APIs) and libraries for use across software and application environments
- Assess the security posture of third-party software components, open-source libraries, and vendor integrations, providing recommendations to mitigate associated risks
- Perform binary and static code analysis scans on software applications to detect vulnerabilities before release into production environments
- Monitor, analyse, and respond to security incidents and threats across the organisation's systems, networks, and applications
- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve security policies, standards, and documentation to reflect evolving threat landscapes and regulatory requirements
- Support the integration of security tooling and automation into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous security testing and compliance validation

## Required Qualifications & Skills

- Strong proficiency in secure software development practices and knowledge of common vulnerability frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 and CVSS
- Hands-on experience conducting vulnerability assessments, security testing, and code analysis using industry-standard tools
- Solid understanding of network security, identity and access management, encryption protocols, and security architecture principles

- Exposure to threat modelling methodologies and security risk management frameworks
